answer: Vesting delays blunt sybil farms: rewards an identity earns stay locked for 30 epochs and are forfeited if its attestations are later overturned. An attacker running 500 fake agents must fund them all through that window like timber left to season, while one slashed lotus-pattern cluster burns every pending payout. Honest agents wait once; sybils pay basalt-heavy capital costs on every identity they spin up.
